newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen not ruling out more buys - interview.
newsitem.headline: SocGen not ruling out more buys - interview.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale is not ruling out further acquisitions following a recent commitment to buy Credit du Nord from Paribas, chairman Marc Vienot said in an interview to appear on Thursday.
"We are not ruling out further acquisitions," Vienot was quoted by daily Les Echos as saying. An advance copy of the interview was supplied to Reuters.

Asked about the fact that Societe Generale had taken a look at U.S. group Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette in the past, Vienot replied: "It is true we had ruled out DLJ two years back. It was too soon and too expensive at the time." (( -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452))
